title: Tamper-evident decision store
one_line: Records that cannot be edited, reordered or deleted without detection.
verified_against: Rust core tests (cargo test -p briefcase-core --all-features) incl. two real OS processes appending to one file; native binding tests through the built extension (maturin develop) incl. two spawned Python processes, Python/Rust verifiers agreeing on tampered databases, and keys made in Python signing in Rust and vice versa; an end-to-end run of briefcase.observe('chain:evidence.db') with @capture in a temp HOME. Not run against network filesystems or on Windows.
